reviews.name: R B
reviews.text:
I got two custom-made, beautiful outfits from Riti Boutique, and they were absolutely stunning. I really want to thank Aparna for being so attentive and thorough; I truly appreciate her efforts. I had a lot of concerns, and Aparna handled them so professionally. All my concerns and questions were updated with so much dedication and love. Thank you so much, Aparna!
Also, I want to thank Aiswarya for her help. Thanks!

reviews.name: Meera C
reviews.text:
I had an upgrade of my wardrobe.  The dresses are so beautiful , flawless, and head turners.  Makes you feel
Like a celebrity.  The staff is so courteous, responsive and guides you so perfectly. Thanks aishwarya.

reviews.name: Abhay 333
reviews.text: Amazing experience at Riti Boutique! Beautiful designs, perfect fitting, and excellent customer service. Will definitely be coming back for more shopping!

reviews.name: Aleena Binu
reviews.text: Good works especially stitching and hand works are too good.Customer friendly and on time.

reviews.name: Santhwana V
reviews.text: Excellent service! The staff were very friendly, professional, and attentive.

reviews.name: sanika dais thomas
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with the staff. It is unfortunate to see such unprofessional behavior in a reputed establishment.

I approached the firm regarding a dress for my wedding photoshoot and inquired about the stitching charges. When I mentioned that my budget was around AED 400, the receptionist literally laughed in my face. I completely understand if my budget did not align with the services offered, but laughing at a customer is disrespectful and unacceptable.

A simple and polite explanation would have been appreciated. Professionalism and basic courtesy should be extended to every customer, regardless of their budget. This experience left me feeling embarrassed and unwelcome.

reviews.name: Revathy Vijay
reviews.text: So happy with the stitching perfection. The quality of the products is excellent, everything feels carefully chosen and well-made.

reviews.name: Idhal
reviews.text: Perfect blouse stitching and excellent customer service! They handled everything so well and made the whole experience pleasant. Highly satisfied and strongly recommended.

reviews.name: Afrah Aboobacker
reviews.text:
I’m so glad I chose Riti  for my big day 🤍✨ Even though it was a last-minute decision, Aparna turned out to be an absolute gem of a designer🫂. She understood my vision perfectly and was incredibly kind, patient, and supportive throughout

Despite not having a trial, the outfit fit me flawlessly, it was lightweight, extremely comfortable, and beautifully crafted♥️ I received so many compliments, and everyone absolutely loved it. Truly a wonderful experience overall 💖✨

reviews.name: sandhya abhilash
reviews.text:
For so many years, I have been purchasing from Riti Boutique, and they have never failed to impress me. Whether it’s a major function or a small event, I can blindly trust Appu, because whatever I imagine, they create even better. Living in Abu Dhabi, it’s difficult to find a place that understands both traditional and modern styles so perfectly—but Riti Boutique always delivers the best.
After seeing one of my outfits, even my cousin from Australia got her churidar stitched from them! I am truly happy with their work and the trust I have in them is beyond words. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Megha Suesh
reviews.text: I had recently stitched two blouses with them and I should say they are amazing. The Stiching was perfect, amazing work. Have stitched from other places but this was really good. I would recommend then to all my friends and family for sure.

reviews.name: Sheetal Abraham
reviews.text:
My absolute favourite boutique 💕 I’ve been a customer of Riti since 2019 in Dubai and even after moving to Australia it’s still my go-to for the most gorgeous outfits! Aparna always understands my style and every piece is stitched to perfection. Most of my ethnic and modern dresses are from Riti and I love their uniqueness and quality.

Recently wore their beautiful dawani for Onam here in Australia and it was such a hit ✨💛 Can’t wait for my next outfit from Riti Boutique!

reviews.name: Sonia Pranav
reviews.text: I ordered three dresses from Riti Boutique UAE, and I am extremely pleased with the entire experience. Each dress was perfectly stitched with elegant designs and excellent finishing. This was my first time giving online measurements, and I was amazed at how perfectly they fit. I was also a bit worried about timely delivery to the UK, but everything arrived right on time. Aparna coordinated everything very smoothly and ensured timely updates, which made the whole process completely hassle-free. Truly impressed with the quality and service—I’m glad to be a customer and would highly recommend Riti Boutique.

reviews.name: Aleena Jolly
reviews.text: "All-time favorite boutique! I love their customized designs, high-quality stitching, and excellent service. Highly recommended!"

reviews.name: Surya Charles
reviews.text: I couldn't be more pleased with my first time stitching service experience. Aparna did help me choose the red colour for lehenga and I can't thank her and her team for the creation, so perfect. It turned out so extraordinary. Her team are really good. It was a great experience. I am sure I will continue having service from this awesome team again. :)

reviews.text: Nice Botique , perfect stitching, and good designs ❣️❣️❣️

reviews.text: One of the best boutique 💕🫶

reviews.name: Nimitha Sonu
reviews.text: I can’t thank Aparna enough for creating the perfect dress for my unforgettable day.The attention to detail and craftsmanship were extraordinary. My dress not only fit like a dream but also made me feel truly beautiful on such a meaningful occasion. If you’re looking for a boutique that brings your dream dress to life, this is the place. I’ll cherish this experience forever!

reviews.name: Sangeetha Gopal
reviews.text: Beautiful Collections and friendly staff. Will definitely recommend to all.

reviews.name: Aathira Narayan
reviews.text: I visited riti boutique to design my wedding dress...and from the started i hv been extremly comfortable with aparna (owner) she was clearly able to put my imagination of my wedding dress into reality...i am very happy with the end product that she created...and her attention to details and our requirements shows her passion towards her profession...kudos to you and your team...will surely be coming back to design more...

reviews.name: Mrudula Sajith
reviews.text:
The most incredible boutique in the northern emirates for the best custom-made dresses. The stitching is impeccable and the customer service is out of this world.

I've had them create dresses for all my special occasions, and they've turned each one into an unforgettable memory.

If you're looking for a truly special dress for your big days, you have to check out this boutique. Trust me, you won't be disappointed!

reviews.name: Sneha Shyju
reviews.text: This dress stole my heart 💙💙💙 I was so excited when I received this beautiful dress 👗 💙 It was an awesome surprise gift from my husband ❤️ though I hadn’t given them my measurements personally,  they made it so well as if they took my measurements personally🫰🏻💙🫂 it was perfect 💙💙💙love love love❤️ I really recommend Riti Boutique for their amazing collections and dedication towards their clients are  impeccable💙💙 you made my day more special with this beautiful dress💙
